title: First Conquest
intro: With gold in your coffers, you've upgraded your fleet.
The small island of Porto Seguro stands before you.
A modest settlement defended by a single coastal fortress.
Its cannons command the harbor approaches.
The Spanish colonists grow wealthy from their plantations and trade.
They've never faced a determined pirate attack.
Take the fortress. Show them that nowhere is safe from your ambition!
victory: The fortress walls crumble under your relentless bombardment!
Spanish soldiers flee inland as your crews storm ashore.
The settlement's treasury is yours: 1500 gold pieces!
Porto Seguro is now under your control.
Your first permanent base of operations.
Word of your victory spreads across the Caribbean.
The name on everyone's lips: Captain of the Sea Rat.
defeat: The fortress guns prove too powerful!
Your ships are battered and broken by the coastal batteries.
You're forced to retreat, leaving the dead behind.
Porto Seguro remains in Spanish hands.
Perhaps you need better ships... or a better plan.
